claim: Apple's June-quarter revenue reached $109.4 billion in fiscal Q3 2026.
summary: The June-quarter equals fiscal Q3 mapping is known, but the specific $109.4 billion revenue figure for fiscal Q3 2026, a period ending after the knowledge cutoff, cannot be verified from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Apple's fiscal Q3 2026 corresponds to the June quarter
sub_claims.note: Apple's fiscal year ends in September, so fiscal Q3 is the June quarter; this general calendar mapping is established knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue in fiscal Q3 2026 was $109.4 billion
sub_claims.note: Fiscal Q3 2026 ended in June 2026, after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04; the specific revenue figure cannot be established from prior knowledge alone.
